args.body:
Dear Yang Xiu,

Thank you for the holiday notice. We understand the factory is closed from 1 to 8 October and that the last shipment before the closure leaves on 28 September.

Three of our lines are already past their promised dates:
- HPO-26-00524 line 10, cover side left (HR-73112), 168 EA, promised 27 August
- HPO-26-00524 line 20, cover side right (HR-73113), 233 EA, promised 28 August
- HPO-26-00599 line 40, light pipe status bar (HR-73410), 2,000 EA, promised 24 September

Please ship whatever you can of these lines by 28 September, and tell us the quantity on each line that will go on that shipment. For any quantity that cannot ship by then, please confirm a firm promise date after the closure, as soon as you can.

Please also confirm the promise dates for your other open lines, HPO-26-00676 lines 10 and 20 (570 EA and 590 EA), given the closure.

Thank you and best regards,
Tom Albrecht
